metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the parish hour, the short loaf, the red thread, the fair copy, and three lines to Anne.

yesterday: The jaw was quiet. Tomorrow is still a tender day.
The penny loaf was a full thumb short of the notch. Board was threepence. The hall candle is the firing. Upstairs candles are yours.
The fair copy runs through the brawl, the feast, the orchard, the friar's cell, the fight, the banishment, and the dawn already written. It is coherent. The marks stay.
The three lines are written. Twopence is Thursday's, when the carrier has the letter.
The morning is the Theatre's. Tomorrow afternoon is the Shrew.
